column1: # TEMPLATE — image_inventory.csv (P4.1.5 PART 3). One row per submitted image.
# filename is the join key across provenance + labels; it must match on disk and never change after upload.
# filename convention: <class_name>_<source_tag>_<seq>.<ext>  (applied at capture; importer preserves it).
# class_name must be a canonical taxonomy class (code-owned).
# license must permit ML training + redistribution. capture_date is ISO-8601.
# self_check: pass | fail  — contributor's §5 self-check result.
# intake_status: pending | accepted | rejected  — set by the data engineer at intake.
